{{Quote|The ''Tonith'' family do not accept ''excuses''. You were to produce 100,000 units by today... And, in exchange, the Banking Clan would make you and your superiors extremely rich.|Reep Tonith, to [[Tarin (Human)|Tarin]]|<ref name="A Trooper's Tale">{{TCWComicCite|6.8|A Trooper's Tale}}</ref>}}
'''Reep Tonith''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] and a member of the influential [[Tonith family]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he was secretly supplied with weaponry by [[Tarin (Human)|Tarin]], a treacherous head of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Czerka factory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belgaroth]]. The Republic dispatched a four-man squad of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to investigate the rumors of Tarin's treachery. Three of the clones were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[droidbreaker]] creature, but the last one, sergeant [[Marrt]], captured Tarin, though Tonith managed to escape.
